{{Youmay|the title|the planet [[Lorrd/Legends|Lorrd]]}}
[[File:Lord_Vader-RotS.png|thumb|right|250px|Lord Vader, a Sith Lord and Supreme Commander in the Galactic Empire.]]
{{Quote|Welcome, Lord Vader. We've been expecting you.|[[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="rots">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
'''Lord''' was a title of [[Noble/Legends|nobility]], [[Deity/Legends|deity]], and, in past times, a [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]].

==History==
===Galactic history===
It was in common use among the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], usually used in lieu of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] when formally referring to [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords of the Sith]], most notably in the cases of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]],<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]]<ref name="Episode II: Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref> and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="rots">{{Film|III}}</ref> The use of this oral form of address could be traced back to the days of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|old Sith]] [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empires]], in the person of [[Aloysius Kallig]]<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> and others such as [[Darth Vindican]]<ref name="name">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20110812-0|text=STAR WARS: The Old Republic Fan Friday}}</ref> and [[Darth Zash]]. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] of the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] were referred to as 'Lord,' including [[Skere Kaan]], [[Qordis]], [[Kas'im]], and [[Kopecz]].

During the [[New Sith Wars]], various high-ranking [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the [[Army of Light]], including [[Hoth (Jedi Lord)|Hoth]], [[Saleeh]], [[Gale]] and [[Valenthyne Farfalla]], also held the title -styled as "[[Jedi Lord]]".<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chair]] [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] was addressed to as "Lord Speaker".<ref name="ROTSNovel">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>

It was considered a great honor to be granted the title of Lord by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine. During the rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] would elevate several loyal servants to the rank and title of Lord for their service to him or for performing a great deed in name of the Empire. The members of the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]] were addressed as such, as was the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military's]] [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]],<ref name="kenner">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (toy line)|pack=Darth Vader vs. Prince Xizor|link=soteKxizor-vader.asp}}</ref> Darth Vader.<ref name="anh">{{Film|IV}}</ref> Following the fragmentation of the Galactic Empire, the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Blitzer Harrsk]] styled himself as "[[Lord High Admiral]]".

===Lords of the Tapani Sector===
Lord was one of the titles of [[Noble/Legends|nobility]] used by the ruling class of the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. Higher than the rank of [[Baron/Legends|Baron]], Lords and Ladies were from the most powerful families in a [[Tapani Noble Houses|noble house]]. They controlled significant House assets, and often took on positions of leadership such as running businesses or commanding the House [[Militia/Legends|militia]]. Lords and Ladies were wealthy, and maintained spacious palaces on both their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworlds]] and [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]]. The [[High Lord]] of a House was appointed from the ranks of a House's Lords.<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>

==Functions and responsibilities==
As a title of nobility, it was recognized by many different worlds as a position of power and authority. Many societies incorporated the title in their way of life and/or as a part of their governments. Several examples include:

*Lords and Ladies of the [[Tapani Noble Houses|noble Houses]] of the [[Expanse]] of the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]].
*Lord [[Tion (Pre-Republic era Lord)|Tion]] of the [[House of Tion/Legends|House of Tion]] of the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]].<ref name="XaV">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/ximweek04/index.html|text=Xim Week: ''The Despotica'' (Part III: Xim at Vondor)|int=Xim Week: The Despotica}}</ref>
*Lord [[Crueya Vandron/Legends|Crueya Vandron]] of [[House Vandron]] of the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]], [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]].
*Lord [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]], [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].<ref name="Legacy of Terror2">{{TCW|Legacy of Terror}}</ref>

As a title of deity, "Lord" was used in various swear words and other phrases. For example, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] was known to use the phrase, "Lord knows how many...."

==Behind the scenes==
"Lord" as used by Leia may be the title of an [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] deity.

Apparently it served as a form of address for the [[Speaker/Legends|Speaker]] of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]; in [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|the ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] addresses [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] as "Lord Speaker."
